# AutoFVMC AI Workspace Instructions

- The product is a commissioning console for iSMA QTQP controllers used as VAV and FPB controllers.
- BACnet/IP and BACnet MS/TP are both required transports.
- Keep BACnet discovery, point reads, validated writes, and MS/TP serial access behind explicit adapter interfaces.
- AI recommendations are advisory. Require visible engineer approval before controller writes.
- Preserve the engineering-tool visual language: dense, scannable, responsive, and operational rather than promotional.
- Keep representative/demo telemetry clearly separate from verified hardware integration.
